sentences: A **fossil** that sat in a museum **drawer** for more than a hundred years has turned out to be a new kind of dinosaur.
The bones were first found on a beach on the Isle of Wight in southern England, and were later kept at a museum in London.
About six years ago, part of the **skull** was noticed again by a scientist at the museum, who thought it looked unusual and asked other researchers to study it more closely.
The team found that the animal lived about one hundred twenty million years ago and **belonged to** a group of hunters with very large **claws** on their hands.
en.answer: 박물관 서랍 속에 백 년 넘게 놓여 있던 화석 하나가 새로운 종류의 공룡인 것으로 밝혀졌다.
